原文: Wait, [i]she[/i] set the fire?
当前译文: 等等，是她放的火？

原文: I don't wish to impose upon a [Player:man/woman] of your standing, but you fascinate me. Will you consider lending me your aid?
当前译文: 我无意冒昧叨扰您这般有身份的人物，但您实在令我着迷。您愿意考虑对我施以援手吗？

原文: No. They know we're coming, but they won't be expecting [i]us[/i].
当前译文: 不怕。他们知道咱们要来，可万想不到来的是咱们。

原文: You send a few shots of your own in their direction, but then the crew of the other ships seems to finally get a good look at [Shipname] and lose their nerve.
当前译文: 你朝他们那边回敬了几箭，可紧接着，其他船上的船员似乎终于瞧清了{船名}的真容，便当即吓破了胆。

原文: There is only [i]one[/i] way to appease them. A [i]sacrifice.[/i]
当前译文: 平息他们的方法唯有一条——[i]献祭[/i]。

原文: [Follower01:Name] rubs [Follower01:his/her] eyes as though to squeeze the sunlight out of them.
当前译文: [Follower01:Name]揉了揉眼睛，像是要把那逼人的阳光全给挤出去。

原文: [Random01:Name] cranes [Random01:his/her] neck to see past the huts.
当前译文: [Random01:Name]伸长了脖子，想望穿那些棚屋的遮挡。

原文: He put [i]you[/i] on it? But-- huh. Well, all right then.
当前译文: 他竟把你写上了那单子？但——嚯，罢了，那便如此吧。

原文: [i]If[/i] trade is what we're planning...
当前译文: 倘若，我们盘算的是通商……

原文: Josteinn [i]the Braggart[/i] being how you are commonly addressed.
当前译文: 游荡诗人约斯泰因——旁人素来这般称呼你。

原文: [Unlucky:Name] manages to secure a decent enough footing that [Unlucky:he/she] can wrestle off [Unlucky:his/her] pack.
当前译文: [不走运：名字]总算找到一个足够扎实的立足点，得以甩开身上[不走运：他/她]那群狼。

原文: Allow me to be the first to greet you in your proper title, your [i]majesty[/i].
当前译文: 请容许我第一个用您真正的头衔来问候您，女王陛下。

原文: [Laugher:Name] lets out a hearty chuckle, as [Laugher:he/she] cheers [Stuck:Name] on.
当前译文: [Laugher:Name]开怀大笑，一边给[Stuck:Name]鼓劲叫好。

原文: [Eater:Name] manages to finish two heaped helpings before leaning back with a loud groan. [Eater:He/She] hiccups and looks for a moment as though [Eater:he/she] is about to be sick.
当前译文: [Eater:Name]硬撑着塞下堆得满满的两大盘，才仰靠椅背，发出一声满足的呻吟。[Eater:He/She]打了个响嗝，那一瞬间的神情，仿佛随时都要吐出来似的。

原文: [Stuck:Name] struggles against the mud, but to no avail. Despite [Stuck: his/her] best efforts, [Stuck:Name] only manages to sink further into the mud.
当前译文: [Stuck:Name]在泥浆中拼命挣扎，却无济于事。尽管[Stuck:他/她]使出了浑身解数，却只能在泥沼中越陷越深。

原文: [Unlucky:He/She] loses [Unlucky:his/her] footing and slides down the cliff, but manages to grab on to a protrusion before falling to [Unlucky:his/her] doom.
当前译文: 【厄运：他/她】脚下一滑，顺着崖壁直坠下去，眼看就要【厄运：他/她】摔个粉身碎骨，总算拼死抓住了一块突出的岩石。

原文: You let [Victim:him/her] dry [Victim:himself/herself] off and sit for some time wrapped in blankets until everyone is ready to continue.
当前译文: 你让【受害者：他/她】擦干身子，裹着毯子坐了一阵，直到所有人都准备好继续赶路。

原文: [Eater:Name] huffs and grunts as [Eater:he/she] attempts to cram the food down. [Eater:He/She] glances at Nukki, then at you - despair on [Eater:his/her] face.
当前译文: [Eater:Name]死命往嘴里塞着食物，呼哧呼哧地直喘粗气。[Eater:He/She]先瞥了努基一眼，又看向你——眼中满是绝望。

原文: [Query:Name] steps up near where you're sitting, [Query:his/her] brow furrowed.
当前译文: [Query:Name]走近你坐的地方，眉头深锁。

原文: [Random01:Name] jabs the king's corpse with [Player:his/her] foot.
当前译文: [Random01:Name]用脚捅了捅国王的尸身。

原文: [CaptainObvious:Name] looks at [CaptainObvious:his/her] feet as if [CaptainObvious:he/she]'s stepped in something.
当前译文: [CaptainObvious:姓名]低头瞅着[CaptainObvious:他/她]的脚，活像是踩着了什么腌臜东西。

原文: [Sherlock:Name] covers [Sherlock:his/her] mouth with [Sherlock:his/her] hand.
当前译文: [夏洛克:角色名]伸手掩住[夏洛克:他/她]的嘴。

原文: That a ruler's only responsibility is to [Player:his/her] people.
当前译文: 身为统领万千之主，此生所背负的，唯有一桩重任——他治下的子民。

原文: Within mere seconds, [Rescuer:Name] explodes out of the water, dragging [Victim:Name] after [Rescuer:him/her].
当前译文: 转瞬之间，[Rescuer:Name]猛地破水而出，身后拖着[Victim:Name]。

原文: [Joker:Name] grins mischievously at [Buzzkill:Name], who is having difficulty reaching a spot on [Buzzkill:his/her] back.
当前译文: 【小丑：[名字]】顽皮地冲着【扫兴鬼：[名字]】咧嘴直笑，【扫兴鬼：[名字]】正费劲够着【扫兴鬼：他/她】背上发痒的地方呢。

原文: [Buzzkill:Name] turns around so [Joker:Name] can get a spot on [Buzzkill:his/her] back.
当前译文: [扫兴者:Name]转过身，好让[玩笑者:Name]在他/她背上找个位置。

原文: Unfortunately [Repairer:Name] - who is not known for [Repairer:his/her] finesse - ends up hurting [Repairer:his/her] hand.
当前译文: 不巧的是，[Repairer:Name]——[Repairer:他/她]的手艺本就谈不上灵巧——反而把自己的手给弄伤了。

原文: After what feels like an eternity, [Rescuer:Name] finally emerges out of the water, dragging [Victim:Name] after [Rescuer:him/her].
当前译文: 感觉像熬过了一辈子那么漫长，[救援者：Name]终于破水而出，身后拖着[遇难者：Name]。

原文: Well [i]that[/i] rope doesn't look suspicious [i]at all[/i].
当前译文: 哼，那根绳子看起来[i]可真够[/i]可疑的。

原文: [Upset:Name] has the leader of the village by his collar. The old man is bleeding profusely, but there's still life in him.
当前译文: 心烦意乱的[Name]揪着村长的衣领。老头儿虽然血流如注，但还有一口气在。

原文: [Impressed:Name] appears to literally lose control of [Impressed:his/her] jaw muscles.
当前译文: [Impressed:Name]的下巴仿佛真真切切地不听使唤，一下脱了臼。

原文: You hike through the mountains has been fairly uneventful. [Klutz:Name] is picking [Klutz:his/her] way back along the ledge when, from the crags above, a predatory shadow swoops down in a blur of feathers and motion.
当前译文: 你在山间的跋涉一路还算太平。[Klutz:Name]正贴着岩架小心翼翼地往回走，就在这时，从上方的巉岩间，一道掠食的暗影裹着一团模糊的羽翼与动作猛扑下来。

原文: [Scout:Name] returns from [Scout:his/her] patrol and reports no sign of the hunter.
当前译文: [Scout:Name]巡逻归来，报告说没有发现那个猎人的踪迹。

原文: [Player:He/She] murdered Steinn! You [Player:bikkju-sonr/bikkja]!
当前译文: [Player:He/She]杀了斯泰因！你这狗崽子！

原文: There must be [i]something[/i] we haven't tried.
当前译文: 肯定还有咱没试过的法儿。

原文: [Finder:Name] fixes you with an incredulous expression, but as [Finder:his/her] eye catches yours, [Finder:he/she] sees the severity behind your words. [Finder:He/She] raises [Finder:his/her] knife to the slave's neck and cuts the young man's throat.
当前译文: [Finder:Name]一脸难以置信地瞪着你，可当[Finder:他/她]对上你的目光，便看出了你话语中的狠厉。[Finder:他/她]把[Finder:他/她的]小刀抵上奴隶的脖子，割开了这年轻人的喉咙。

原文: Hey there. How's it going?
当前译文: 嘿，[Player:哥哥/姐姐]。最近如何？

原文: Your choice of emissary was somewhat odd, but I came to see the wisdom of it in the end. It's unlikely I would've stood before you had you sent anyone of less... [i]proficiency[/i].
当前译文: 你派的使者是有点古怪，但我到头来倒看出了其中的妙处。要是你派个本事稍差些的人来……我恐怕就不会站到你面前了。

原文: That is [i]my[/i] business, Skule.
当前译文: 这与你无关，斯库勒。

原文: Ah! Oh, my dear [Player:boy/girl], I'm so glad you're alive!
当前译文: 啊！哦，我亲爱的孩子，你还活着，我真是太高兴了！

原文: You and your hird each picks an attacker to search. [Finder:Name] raises [Finder:his/her] hand, holding something that glimmers in the light.
当前译文: 你和你的侍卫队各挑了一个袭击者搜身。[发现者:名字]举起手来，指间捏着什么，在光影里微微闪亮。

原文: It's the same [i]cursed[/i] disease! I have to do something - we [i]have[/i] to get rid of this once and for all!
当前译文: 是同一种遭天谴的恶疾！我必须做点什么——我们必须斩草除根，永绝后患！

原文: You think [i]that[/i] was a strong hit?! Pah!
当前译文: 你觉得那也算重击？！呸！

原文: I don't know how to say that. I get their meaning but I can't [i]speak[/i] that language!
当前译文: 我不知那话该怎么说。我能听懂个大概，可讲是讲不来的！

原文: Oh! What [i]is[/i] that? Is that [i]gold[/i]?
当前译文: 喔！那是个什么？是金子不成？

原文: I saw her leave around midnight, but I thought she was just going hunting. Now that I think about it, she [i]was[/i] carrying a lot of stuff.
当前译文: 我在差不多午夜时分瞅见她离开，只当她是去打个猎。如今回想起来，她当时带的东西是挺多。

原文: You?! He sent [i]you[/i] to ensure that?! How in the names of the saints did he imagine [i]that[/i] would go over?
当前译文: 你？！他居然派了你来担保此事？！看在诸圣的份儿上，他脑子里到底是怎么盘算的，觉得这能行得通？

原文: You [i]bitch![/i]
当前译文: 你这贱人！

原文: [Insulted:Name] mutters under [Insulted:his/her] breath.
当前译文: [Insulted:Name]低声咕哝着。

原文: Shit, what have they [i]done[/i] to you?
当前译文: 操，他们到底对你做了什么？

原文: Hah! To be completely honest, the boy feeds [i]me[/i] these days, not the other way around.
当前译文: 哈！跟你说实话，如今呀，可是这小子养着我这把老骨头，哪里轮得到我来养他。

原文: [i]One[/i] change of clothes?
当前译文: 就一身换洗衣服？

原文: [Archer01:Name] crosses [Archer01:his/her] arms, a hint of frustration in [Archer01:his/her] voice.
当前译文: [Archer01:Name]双臂交叉，[Archer01:his/her]声音里流露出一丝挫败感。

原文: [Drinker:Name] chokes and ale sprays over the rim of the cup. [Drinker:He/She] flings it aside as [Drinker:he/she] is seized by a coughing fit, falling forward onto [Drinker:his/her] hands and knees. Tears and snot run down [Drinker:Name]'s face as [Drinker:he/she] heaves for air.
当前译文: [Drinker:Name]被呛得啤酒喷溅，洒出杯沿。[Drinker:He/She]甩开杯子，整个人被一阵剧烈咳嗽攫住，向前扑倒，双手双膝撑在地上。眼泪和鼻涕糊了[Drinker:Name]满脸，[Drinker:he/she]拼命喘着粗气。

原文: If that is true, Hrodgærda's actions will reflect very poorly indeed on Thegn Skule. I will have my people bring this captain to me so I can hear the words out of [i]his[/i] mouth.
当前译文: 若此言属实，那赫罗德盖尔达的行径，可真叫斯库勒领主颜面尽失了。我这就差人把那首领押来，我要听他亲口招认。

原文: [Cougher:Name] coughs up a particularly large amount of water as [Cougher:he/she] emerges, gasping for air after each cough. [Cougher:He/She] doesn't look too good after the swim.
当前译文: [呛水者：名字]浮出水面时，咳出了特别大的一口水，每咳一下都大口喘着气。[呛水者：他/她]游完这一趟，看起来状态糟透了。

原文: Gods, she was [i]so[/i] excited to see me like this. I'll never hear the end of it.
当前译文: 诸神在上，她见我这般模样，简直乐坏了。这事儿，定会被她念叨一辈子。

原文: Just give [Player:him/her] the stuff, Nott. You don't need it, you fight just fine without it.
当前译文: 只管把东西给他/她呗，诺特。你又用不上，赤手空拳你也照样能打。

原文: [Drinker:Name] gulps and gasps as [Drinker:he/she] struggles with the ale. [Drinker:He/She] lowers the cup for a moment, fighting for breath - despair on [Drinker:his/her] face.
当前译文: [饮者:姓名] 大口灌下麦芽酒，被呛得一阵猛咳，喘不过气来。[饮者:他/她] 不得不暂时搁下杯子，拼命喘着粗气——脸上写满了绝望。

原文: [Pessimist:Name] rolls [Pessimist:his/her] eyes conspicuously.
当前译文: [Pessimist:Name]夸张地翻了个白眼。

原文: As [Stuck:Name] is yanked free, [Stuck:he/she] loses [Stuck:his/her] balance, stumbles forward for a few steps, then falls down.
当前译文: [Stuck:Name]被猛地挣脱时，顿失平衡，朝前踉跄了几步，旋即一头栽倒在地。

原文: Eventually [Fisher:Name] grows too exhausted, the line slips from [Fisher:his/her] fingers, and the sea creature vanishes into the waves.
当前译文: 终于，[Fisher:Name]筋疲力尽，指间的钓线倏地滑脱，那头庞大的海兽就此消失在波涛之下。

原文: [Lover:Name] stirs in [Lover:his/her] sleep, and mumbles something comforting. [Lover:His/Her] hand gropes in the dark, finds yours, and squeezes weakly.
当前译文: [Lover:Name]在睡梦中动了动身子，喃喃地说了些宽慰的话。[Lover:His/Her]的手在黑暗中摸索着，寻到了你的手，虚弱地握了握。

原文: Thegn [Player:Name] [Player:Lastname] of Skjern and [Player:his/her] fierce warriors have done a great deal for this kingdom. For this, [Player:Name], I pledge to support your own campaign in Jutland.
当前译文: 斯基恩的领主[Player:Name][Player:Lastname]及其麾下勇猛的战士们，为这个王国立下了汗马功劳。鉴于此，[Player:Name]，我立誓支持你征战日德兰。

原文: Oh, hm... well. Now that I think about it, I've heard that girl Suthen, who makes pottery a ways up the river, has a [i]thing[/i] with Cailtram.
当前译文: 哦，嗯……这个嘛。容我细想一下，我听说在上游做陶器的那个姑娘苏森，跟凯尔特拉姆有那么一腿。

原文: Who are [i]we?[/i] Who are [i]you?![/i]
当前译文: 谁是“我们”？你又是谁？！

原文: Tell me: how [i]do[/i] you plan to govern us?
当前译文: 告诉我：你究竟打算如何治理我们？

原文: [Player:He/She] who is defeated may swear fealty to the winner, or [Player:his/her] life is forfeit. If either of us falls in the duel, their body shall be buried here.
当前译文: 落败一方[i]可[/i]向胜者宣誓效忠，否则[i]其[/i]性命将被剥夺。若我二人中有人在决斗中倒下，他的尸身将安葬于此。

原文: [Initial:Name]'s boots sink into the sand as [Initial:he/she] jumps the few feet from the ship, weapon in hand.
当前译文: [Initial:Name]从船上跳下几英尺，双脚陷进沙里，手握兵器。

原文: [VoiceOfReason:Name] whispers in your ear as you hand your weapons to [VoiceOfReason:him/her] for safe-keeping.
当前译文: 你把武器交给[VoiceOfReason:Name]保管时，[VoiceOfReason:he/she]凑到你耳边，低语了几句。

原文: [Stuck:Name] starts wrestling against the mud. Despite [Stuck:his/her] difficulties, [Stuck:he/she] manages to pull out [Stuck:himself/herself] using a nearby branch for balance.
当前译文: [被困：名字]在烂泥里挣扎起来。尽管[被困：他/她]陷得艰难，却还是借着旁边一根树枝稳住重心，把自己硬拔出泥沼。

原文: You simply [i]must[/i] be joking.
当前译文: 你一定是在说笑。

原文: [Player:Velkominn/Velkomin] back, gracious thegn. Are you looking to restock your supplies?
当前译文: 欢迎归来，仁慈的乡绅。您可是要补充些随行物资？

原文: Watch who you call barbarian, [i]peasant![/i]
当前译文: 你这野蛮人叫谁蛮子呢，贱民！

原文: All these soldiers produce a [i]lot[/i] of refuse.
当前译文: 这么多当兵的扎在一处，造的垃圾可真他娘的不少。

原文: Not being one to back down, [Slippy:Name] gets back up and tries again. This time, with great difficulty, [Slippy:he/she] reaches the landing.
当前译文: [Slippy:Name]可不是个轻易退缩的人，[Slippy:他/她]重新站起来，再次尝试。这一次，费了九牛二虎之力，[Slippy:他/她]总算登了上去。

原文: Oh...? But I thought Cailtram was already [i]with[/i] Conall.
当前译文: 哦……？可我本以为卡尔特拉姆已经和康纳尔在一起了。

原文: Most of your hirdmen manage the climb, but [Slippy:Name] loses [Slippy:his/her] grip, falls back down, and hurts [Slippy:his/her] leg.
当前译文: 你的扈从大多攀了上去，唯独[Slippy:Name]失手滑落，重重摔下，伤了[Slippy:his/her]的腿。

原文: [Random01:Name] struggles back on [Random01:his/her] feet.
当前译文: [Random01:Name]挣扎着重新站了起来。

原文: Oh! So [i]that's[/i] where you went.
当前译文: 哦！原来你是跑那儿去了。

原文: {Face Asleifr in the ring.} Your offer humbles me, but this is [i]my[/i] fight.
当前译文: {在决斗圈中面对阿斯莱夫。} 您的提议令我不胜荣幸，但这乃是我自己的战斗。

原文: The craftsmen pack their gear quickly and let [CraftsmenEscort:Name] say [CraftsmenEscort:his/her] goodbyes.
当前译文: 几个匠人麻利地收拾起家什，由着[CraftsmenEscort:Name]去话别。

原文: Have it your way, [i]monk[/i].
当前译文: 随你怎么嘴硬，修士。

原文: {Signal to [Partner:Name] to kill the old man while you take out the young.} I am to show you this token. The bishop said you would understand.
当前译文: {向[搭档:姓名]示意，你去解决老的，让[搭档:姓名]干掉小的。} 我奉命来给你看这信物。主教说了，你一望便知。

原文: You are a wise and reasonable [Player:man/woman]. I pray that your decision here will not bring you more trouble.
当前译文: 你是个明智又通情达理的男人/女人。我祈求你今日的决定，不会为你招来更多麻烦。

原文: I think these are the orphans [Player:Name] mentioned after [Player:he/she] interrogated the spy at Æthelred's camp.
当前译文: 我想这几个就是[Player:Name]在埃塞尔雷德营地审过那个间谍后，提到的孤儿。

原文: [Hurt01:Name] slips on the wet ledge and nearly plummets to [Hurt01:his/her] doom, but fortunately another hirdman catches [Hurt01:him/her] in time.
当前译文: [Hurt01:姓名]在湿滑的岩架上脚下一滑，差点坠入深渊，多亏另一个侍卫眼疾手快，才把[Hurt01:他/她]从鬼门关里拽了回来。

原文: If it came to that, surely there'd be a better resolution. Asleifr has the sense [i]and[/i] the stubornness of a mule, but he's still family.
当前译文: 真要到那个地步，肯定有更好的解决法子。阿斯莱弗的脑筋和脾气都犟得像头骡子，但他终究是家人。

原文: [Handler:Name] handles the two bloated corpses as best [Handler:he/she] can. The [Handler:archetype] recoils at the smell and afterwards looks quite nauseous.
当前译文: [Handler:Name]强忍着处理那两具肿胀的尸体。那股恶臭熏得[Hander:he/she]直往后缩，完事后看上去随时要吐出来。

原文: Should [Player:he/she] survive, [Player:he/she] who is defeated may swear fealty to the winner, or [Player:his/her] life is forfeit. If either of us falls in the duel, their body shall be buried here.
当前译文: 若[Player:他/她]能活下来，落败者须向胜者宣誓效忠，否则便以性命相抵。我二人决斗，任谁倒下，尸身便葬于此地。

原文: [Helper:Name] extends [Helper:his/her] hand and starts pulling. It's clearly difficult for them both. [Helper:Name] eventually manages to free [Stuck:Name] in a last-ditch yank.
当前译文: [Helper:Name]伸出手，开始往外拖人。两个人都明显使出了吃奶的劲。最终，[Helper:Name]拼尽全力猛地一拽，总算是把[Stuck:Name]给拉了出来。

原文: Pay them, you arrogant [i]nidingr[/i]! Or [i]else[/i]...
当前译文: 付钱给他们，你这不可一世的懦夫！否则的话……

原文: You really [i]are[/i] [Player:Father]'s [Player:son/daughter], aren't you? Just take care not to lose touch of your people's needs in your eagerness to defend them.
当前译文: 你果真是[Player:Father]的[Player:son/daughter]，对吧？只是切莫在急切保护你的人民时，忘了体察他们的疾苦。

原文: [Random01:Name] mutters under [Random01:his/her breath].
当前译文: [Random01:Name]低声嘟囔了一句。

原文: All that doesn't concern me, of course, but he took off wearing a fine hide coat and an expensive sword - [i]my[/i] fine hide coat and expensive sword!
当前译文: 当然，那档子事本与我无关，可他是穿着我上好的皮袄、佩着我贵重的宝剑溜走的——那可是[em]我的[/em]上好皮袄和贵重的宝剑！

原文: [Helper:Name] extends [Helper:his/her] hand and starts pulling. [Stuck:Name] is eventually freed without further incident.
当前译文: [Helper:Name]伸出手去，开始用力拖拽。[Stuck:Name]终于被弄了出来，所幸没再发生什么意外。

原文: [Random01:Name] jumps back to [Random01:his/her] feet with a nod.
当前译文: [Random01:Name]应了一声，一个翻身便跃了起来。

原文: So you [i]are[/i] spying for Osred. Thank you for admitting it.
当前译文: 你这果然是在替奥斯雷德刺探情报。多谢你坦然承认。

原文: [Naysayer:Name] clears [Naysayer:his/her] throat awkwardly.
当前译文: [Naysayer:Name]尴尬地清了清嗓子。

原文: Thinking quickly, [ScoutCapturer:Name] manages to place [ScoutCapturer:himself/herself] between one of the travellers and his weapon.
当前译文: 急中生智的[ScoutCapturer:Name]闪身挡在了一名旅伴和他的武器之间。

原文: When I see that everyone is dead, [i]then[/i] I will come with you. Then you can bring me to the end of the world for all I care.
当前译文: 等我亲眼看着所有人都死光，那时我才会跟你走。到那时，就算你带我去天涯海角，我也无所谓了。

原文: You know, I too am a good thegn. Why don't [i]you[/i] submit to [i]me[/i]? Skjern is a lovely place - the fresh sea air might do you good.
当前译文: 你知道吗，我也是个好首领。你为何不臣服于[i]我[/i]呢？斯克恩是个好地方——海边的空气清新，或许对你有些好处。

原文: A short, stout woman is sorting valuable trinkets from a pile of sacks into three crates, according to some arcane system that only she probably understands. Though the trinkets don't look heavy, she emits a very quiet [size=8]"yah"[/size] every time she picks one up.
当前译文: 一个矮壮的女人正按着某种大概只有她自己才懂的玄妙章法，把堆在麻袋里的值钱小玩意儿分拣进三只木箱。虽说这些小物件看着不沉，但她每拾起一件，都会发出一声极细微的“嘿呀”声。

原文: What a splendid feast for such a [i]shit[/i] thegn!
当前译文: 对一个如此[狗屎不如]的塞恩来说，这场盛宴可真够气派的！

原文: Nothing! [i]Nothing[/i] is what I have left!
当前译文: 什么都没了！我只剩下个[一无所有]！

原文: You [i]bikkju-sonr[/i]! I ought to kill you where you stand!
当前译文: 你这[狗崽子]！我真该就地宰了你！

原文: No [i]-hck-[/i] no more... I give...
当前译文: 不——哈咳——别再打了……我认输……

原文: You wash away the sap with water from the stream, but nothing more. With some dismay, [Victim:Name] sets [Victim:his/her] face with a pained expression and nods. [Victim:He/She] winces as you move on, and the redness develops into a vicious rash over the next few hours.
当前译文: 你用溪水洗去了树汁，但仅此而已。[Victim:Name]有些沮丧，面露疼痛之色，点了点头。你继续处理时，[Victim:他/她]痛得直咧嘴，接下来几个时辰里，那片红肿急剧恶化，成了一片狰狞的皮疹。

原文: Ottarr you miserable drunkard! How [i]dare[/i] you attack your thegn's honour during [Player:his/her] own feast! Your family will pay for this!
当前译文: 奥塔尔，你这灌饱了黄汤的泼才！竟敢在[Player:他/她]自己的盛宴上，往你家首领脸上抹黑！你的家眷就等着为此偿债吧！

原文: Ah, but I know there's no stopping you young [Player:men/women] when your mind is made up. All right, all right, I'll see what I have.
当前译文: 唉，可我也知道，你们这些年轻人一旦拿定了主意，天王老子也拦不住。行吧，行吧，我来瞧瞧家底。

原文: [Laugher:Name] laughs uncontrollably at the situation [Stuck:Name] has gotten [Stuck:himself/herself] into. [Stuck:Name] is chuckling along with a hint of desparation.
当前译文: [Laugher:Name]看着[Stuck:Name]惹上这身麻烦，笑得直不起腰。[Stuck:Name]也跟着笑，那笑声里却透着一丝绝望。

原文: This trap wouldn't surprise a [i]cow[/i].
当前译文: 这破陷阱，连头牛都骗不过。

原文: If only you fought for me, Nefja. If you should win this, I hope [Player:Name] will be a better thegn than [Player:his/her] father.
当前译文: 内芙娅，倘或你是为我而战该多好。若你这回赢了，我只盼[Player:Name]能比他老子强，做个更像样的领主。

原文: [Klutz:Name] tumbles and rolls madly as [Klutz:he/she] plummets into the ravine.
当前译文: [Klutz:姓名]坠入峡谷，一路疯狂翻滚磕碰。

原文: The hermit is under our protection. If you attack him, you will be [i]crushed[/i].
当前译文: 那位隐修士受我等庇护。若你敢动他一根汗毛，定叫你粉身碎骨。

原文: In a desperate last lurch forward, you breach the surface of the water. Greeting you there is [Diver:Name], who helps you up while you cough up the water and gasp for air. It looks like the dive was tough on [Diver:him/her] as well.
当前译文: 在最后一次绝望的扑腾中，你猛地冲破了水面。[潜者:他/她]也一样吃不消。

原文: [Victim:He/She] gives a grunt of frustration as [Victim:he/she] flounders in the plant-choked stream. Pushing aside the long, broad-leaf-tipped stalk, the [Victim:archetype] clambers back out again with a steady stream of muttered complaints.
当前译文: [受害者:他/她]在那条被水草壅塞的溪流里挣扎着，发出一声恼怒的低吼。用手挡开那又长又宽、叶子跟矛尖似的水草茎，[受害者:原型]嘴里不住地低声咒骂着，笨拙地爬回了岸上。

原文: Don't you remember what you said? "It's better to lead than to follow." Those are [i]your[/i] words. Well I've finally decided to take your advice.
当前译文: 你难道不记得自己说过的话了？“与其随人俯仰，不如昂然引领。”这话可是你自己说出口的。好了，如今我终于拿定主意，要听听你这番劝告。

原文: After three massive helpings, [Eater:Name] seems to be in a haze. [Eater:His/Her] jaw works and chews though there is nothing more in [Eater:his/her] mouth.
当前译文: 三大份饭菜下肚，[Eater:Name]已是眼神迷离，神游天外。[Eater:His/Her]下巴却还在机械地动着，嘴里分明早已没了食物，却仍嚼个不停。

原文: [Eater:Name]'s hiccups, sways for a moment, and then suddenly scrambles frantically to disentangle [Eater:him/her]self from the table. [Eater:He/She] Manages a few steps before doubling over and retching, spilling sick in a stinking puddle of bile and and reeking mush.
当前译文: [Eater：名字]猛抽了几声逆嗝，身子晃了晃，随即发了疯似地拼命把自个儿从桌边撕扯开。[Eater：他/她]勉力撑出几步，便猛地弯下腰大呕起来，呕出一摊混着胆汁的恶臭浆水，酸秽逼人。

原文: [Hunter/Huntress]
当前译文: 猎人/女猎人

原文: [day] the [daynumber][dayend] of [month], year [year]
当前译文: [year]年，[month]月[daynumber]日，[day]
